capabilities: show vault name, current file and mode in Discord Rich Presence
customize status lines with placeholders like {file}, {mode} and {meta:key}
hide presence via pause mode, idle detection or glob-pattern exclusions
add up to two custom profile buttons with labels and URLs
monitor connection via a status bar indicator with reconnect
extras: Desktop only; Discord must be running locally and Obsidian 1.4.0+ is required. Discord never shows your own buttons on your own profile, so someone else must verify them.
problem: Obsidian activity is invisible to others; there is no built-in way to broadcast what you are working on to Discord.

relations.evidence: Show your Obsidian activity on Discord via Rich Presence

requires.name: custom Discord Application (optional, for own images)

summary: Discord Rich Presence integration that shows your current vault, file, edit/reading mode and an elapsed timer in your Discord profile.
